scope: Two preview-only terrain refinement images; depth appearance only, no mechanics or integration.

proposed_depth_colors.status: Assistant-proposed preview colors, not accepted gameplay palette

prompts:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one refined pixel-art tactical scene preview, same 1448x1086 framing as Image 1.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, an existing simple pixel-terrain battlefield. Image 2 is the user's WARRIOR STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: study its chunky connected pixel clusters, restrained 3-4 flat shade planes, selective edge highlights and controlled dark contours. Do not paste the large warrior into the image, do not replace all characters with that warrior, do not copy its black/transparent backdrop.
USER REQUEST: add ONLY A TINY BIT of terrain detail to make the simple landscape harmonize with this warrior's pixel-art finish. Also add clear shallow and deep water, with the bottom slightly visible in shallow water.
Keep the existing scene simple, sparse and recognizably the same as image 1. Broad quiet floor surfaces should dominate. Refine just selected edges and materials with a few cohesive pixel clusters: a small angled light plane, a short bevel highlight, a rare chip or grass clump, a broad dirt plane. Make the terrain a little more finished, not more elaborate. Regular crisp pixel steps, no blurry antialiasing, painterly smoothing or global pixelation filter. NO blanket mottled texture, dither, single-pixel noise, brick subdivisions, pebbles scattered across every tile, lots of cracks, reeds, extra foliage or tiny sparkle. Preserve the subdued green/earth/slate palette and the flat blue background.
WATER DEPTH IS REQUIRED AND MUST BE VISUALLY OBVIOUS:
- Along accessible banks, a coherent band of SHALLOW WATER in muted lighter blue-green (#62887E / #86AAA8). The submerged bottom must be faintly but CLEARLY VISIBLE: broad sand/earth or stone planes in muted #978971/#A6967B or cool slate, softly tinted by the water layer, with at most two larger simple flat submerged stones in the entire scene. It must read as water above a floor, not opaque turquoise paint. Show the submerged floor contour/material and one or two restrained pixel surface strokes across it.
- Deeper central water is cooler and darker (#315361 with #3E6570/#527F87) and its bottom is NOT visible. Keep deep water distinct from the dark void/background.
- Transition in broad stepped natural-looking pixel masses, not a smooth realistic gradient, not perfectly striped concentric outlines. No scientific legend, depth numbers, cross section or labels. About one third shallow near banks, remaining connected deeper channel/basin. Very sparse short pale angular reflections; no caustic net, gloss, waves, realistic transparency or foam.
Palette anchors: grass #64785A/#7D9270/#98A286; earth #685844/#92775B/#978971/#A6967B; stone/metal #5D7078/#9DADB0, contour #202C31, warm wood #725443/#B18D68. Acid #7DAC73/#ADD6AA with restrained #BDCF86 yellow-green, opaque flat pixel puddle with two stepped bubbles, clearly distinct from transparent blue-green shallows. Fire #B9604E/#D58E4F/#ECC577 in a few crisp connected pixel flame clusters. Violet rune #8E7FA4/#C3B9D2. Preserve original UI colors.
LOCK: exact overall board composition, steep top diamond 4:3 camera, map boundary, tile count and grid directions, raised blocks, bridge/walls, existing six character identities/poses/scale/positions, feet/contact shadows/bars, hazard locations. No new obstacles or units. Keep all HUD text, buttons, font, layout and surrounding background visually unchanged. This is a small terrain/material finish pass plus water depth. Do not recreate the older ornate landscape. Keep terrain contrast gentler than the warrior figures. One full scene image, no collage/swatches/title. Preview only, no claim of game implementation.
SCENE 1: GRASSLAND FORD.
Keep the two simple grassy banks, one bridge, single raised rear block, one cube obstacle, one spike trap, acid and fire exactly as positioned in Image 1. Add light coherent edge planes to only a few earth/grass corners. At most three small extra grass clusters across the entire map, not one per tile; keep large plain grass interiors. Bridge receives a short plank edge highlight and one darker end grain plane, no micrograin. Refine existing trap/cube planes with the same angular steel shading quality as the warrior reference but do not increase object geometry. Show sandy SHALLOWS along both riverbanks, with the brown/tan riverbed visible under lightly teal water, and a continuous darker DEEP channel through the middle passing under the existing bridge. Broad flat depths, sparse surface strokes, no new bank cuts, no shoreline boulders. Depth contrast and hints of submerged riverbed are the most important new information.
